Golisopod

Bug Water

Alola · Generation 7

Golisopod is a Bug/Water-type Hard Scale Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 2 m tall and weighs 108 kg. It evolves from Wimpod. Its highest base stat is Defense (140), with a base stat total of 530.
